description: Synthetic knowledge base for a ceramic-tile firing line. Maps measurable sensor behaviour to documented failure modes. All ranges are illustrative for a SIMULATED line and are not real industrial thresholds.

failure_modes.cause: Kiln overheating causing thermal-stress surface cracking
failure_modes.rationale: Firing temperature above the documented band induces thermal stress that can produce micro-cracks and surface crazing on tiles.

failure_modes.cause: Mechanical misalignment / excess vibration marring the surface
failure_modes.rationale: Elevated vibration from worn bearings or misalignment can transfer to the product and cause surface defects.
A sustained rise in motor current can indicate a conveyor jam or drive overload disturbing the process.
Firing temperature below the documented band can leave tiles under-fired, changing appearance and strength.
